# Spaceship Logistics Analytics

> Logistics analytics platform over synthetic order operations data.

Live demo: https://logistics-analytics-demo.ghiffariahmadijaya.workers.dev

## Workspaces
- [Overview Workspace](https://logistics-analytics-demo.ghiffariahmadijaya.workers.dev/#overview): Operational KPIs, order volume trends, and delivery performance metrics.
- [Forecasts Workspace](https://logistics-analytics-demo.ghiffariahmadijaya.workers.dev/#forecasts): Known-SKU demand coverage forecasts with an adjustable 1–4 month horizon and visible planning buffer.

The natural-language assistant routes one validated operation through Workers AI when enabled; all returned analytics and forecast values are computed by the application. The forecast is a sparse-history demand-coverage baseline with a visible planning buffer. It does not estimate trend or uncertainty and is not a net purchase quantity.
